translations.text: Let us sing to the Lord, for he is gloriously glorified; horses and riders he has cast into the sea.
He became a helper and protector for us, as a deliverer; this is our God, and let us glorify him, the God of our father, and let us exalt him.
It is the Lord who shatters battles; Lord is his name.
The chariots of Pharaoh and all his people he cast into the sea; the chosen riders of the captains he drowned in the Red Sea.
The sea covered them; they went down and sank like stones into the depth of the abysses.
Your right hand, O Lord, is glorious in your strength. Your right hand, O Lord, destroyed those enemies of yours.
By the multitude of your glory you shattered those who rise against you; you sent forth the wrath of your anger, and it devoured them like reeds.
By the breath of the might of your anger the waters were parted; the waters of the sea were walled up and stood like walls, and the waves congealed and were walled up in the midst of the sea.
The enemy said: I will pursue, I will overtake, I will strike, I will divide the spoil and glut myself, I will slay him with my sword; my hand shall have dominion and be exalted over them.
You sent forth your spirit, and the sea covered them; they were thrown into confusion and went down like lead in the mighty waters.
Who is like you among the gods, O Lord, or who can be likened to you in glory among the holy ones? You are wondrous in glory, you who have done signs and miracles.
You stretched out your right hand, and the earth engulfed them.
You led by your righteousness this people of yours, the people whom you redeemed; you comforted by your strength this camp of your holiness.
The nations heard and were enraged, and anguish seized the inhabitants of Philistia.
Then the chiefs of Edom and the rulers of the Moabites hastened; fear and trembling seized them, and all the inhabitants of Canaan melted away.
Let fear and trembling fall upon them; by the might of your arm let them become stone, until your people pass over, O Lord, until this people of yours whom you chose pass over,

until you bring them in and plant them on the mountain of your holiness, in the prepared place built for your dwelling, the sanctuary which you acquired from the beginning, O Lord, which your hands prepared, O Lord.
The Lord is king forever and forever and ever, and beyond.

For Pharaoh went with chariots and riders into the midst of the sea, and the water of the Red Sea turned back and covered them, but the children of Israel walked as on dry land in the midst of the sea.
Give heed, O heaven, and I will speak, and let the earth hear the words of my mouth.
Await my voice as rain; let my words come down like dew, like rain upon green plants and like snow upon grass.
For we have called upon the name of the Lord; give glory to our God.
Our God: his works are in truth, and all his ways are in justice; God is faithful, and there is no falsehood with him; just and holy is the Lord.
They sinned against him, those offspring of defilement, a crooked and perverse generation.
This is the recompense this mad and unwise people has repaid to the Lord. Was it not he himself, your father, who acquired you, made you and created you?
Remember the days of old, and consider the years from generation to generation. Ask your father, and he will tell you, and your elders, and they will inform you.
When the Most High divided the nations, as he scattered the sons of Adam, he established the boundaries of the peoples according to the number of the angels of God.
The Lord's portion was his people Jacob, and the lot of his inheritance was Israel.
He kept them from lack in the desert, in the thirst of the heat and in the waterless land; he surrounded them and instructed them, and he guarded them like the pupil of the eye,
as an eagle shelters its nest and yearned for its young: it spread its wings and gathered them and lifted them up on its shoulders.
The Lord alone led them, and no other god was with them.
He brought them up onto the strength of the land and fed them the fruit of the fields; they ate honey from the rock and oil from the mighty rock;
butter of cows, milk of sheep, with the fat of lambs and rams, of the offspring of bulls and of goats, with the fat of the kidneys of wheat; and they drank the blood of the grape, wine.
Jacob ate and was filled, and the beloved one kicked; he grew fat, grew thick, grew broad; he abandoned God his Maker and fell away from God his Savior.
They enraged me with their foreign services, and with their idols they embittered me;
they sacrificed to demons and made no offering to God, to gods whom they did not know, worthless ones, lately brought in, whom their fathers did not know.
Now you have abandoned the God who begot you, and you have forgotten God who raised you.
The Lord saw this, and he was jealous and was enraged with wrath because of their sons and daughters.
And the Lord said: I will turn my face away from them and make known what is to happen to them in later times; for this generation is perverse offspring, in whom there is no faith.
They made me jealous with their no-gods and enraged me with their idols; now I too will make them jealous over a despised nation, and by a foolish nation I will destroy them.
For a fire has flared up from my wrath; it will burn down to the lowest hell, it will devour the earth with its fruit, and it will scorch the foundations of the mountains.
I will gather evils upon them and spend my arrows on them.

They will perish by hunger and be given as food to the birds, and a twisting pain will fall upon them; I will send against them the teeth of wild beasts, which drag themselves along the ground in wrath.
Outside, the sword will leave them without heirs, and from their inner chambers, fear: young men and virgins, sucklings along with those advanced in days.
I said: I will scatter them and make their memory cease from among people,

were it not for the wrath of the enemies, so that they might not last a long time, and so that their assailants might not multiply, and so that they might not say: Our hand has been raised higher than theirs, and it was not the Lord who did all this.
For this nation is one that plots destruction, and there is no knowledge in them.
They did not come to know their own understanding; let them lay this up for the times to come.
How could one chase thousands and two put myriads to flight, had God not given them away and the Lord not handed them over?
For their idols are not like our God, but our enemies have become senseless.
For their vine is from the vine of the Sodomites, and their vineyards from the Gomorrahites; their grapes are grapes of gall, and theirs is a cluster of bitterness.
Their wine was the wrath of dragons and the incurable fury of asps.
Behold, I have gathered all this; it is sealed and kept in my treasuries.
On the day of vengeance I will repay them, at the time when their feet have slipped; for the day of their destruction is near, and what has been prepared has come upon them.
For the Lord will judge his people and comfort his servants; for he saw them lacking, enfeebled, carried off captive and exhausted.
And the Lord said: Now where are those gods of yours, in whom you trusted?
For you ate the fat of their sacrifices and drank the wine of their libations; now let them arise and help you and be your protectors.
See, see that it is I, and there is no other god besides me; I put to death and I give life, I wound and I heal, and there is no one who can escape from my hand.
For I will lift my hand to heaven and swear by my right hand and say: I live forever.
I will sharpen my sword like lightning and make ready my hand for judgment; I will seek vengeance [?] and render judgment to my enemies, and I will repay those who hate me.
I will make my arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall eat flesh, from the blood of the wounded and of the captives, from the heads of the rulers and of the enemies.

Rejoice with him, O heavens, and let all the sons of God worship him; rejoice, O nations, with his people, and let all the angels of God strengthen him; for he will seek out the blood of his sons, he will take vengeance and render judgment to his enemies, he will repay those who hate him, and the Lord will cleanse the land of his people.
My heart was strengthened in the Lord, and my horn was lifted up in God my Savior; I opened my mouth wide against my enemies, I rejoiced in your salvation.
For no one is holy like you, O Lord, and no one is holy apart from you; and no one is righteous like our God.
Do not boast, and do not speak lofty things beyond measure, and let no word come out of your mouth richly; for God is the Lord of knowledge, and God prepares his works.
The bows of the mighty have grown weak, and the weak have been clothed with strength.
Those who were full have lacked bread, and the hungry have taken possession of the land. For the barren woman has had seven children, and she who had many children has grown weak.
The Lord puts to death and gives life, he casts down into hell and brings up again.
The Lord makes poor and makes rich, he brings low and lifts up.

He raises the poor man from the ground and lifts up the fallen from the dunghills; he seats him with the mighty, with the mighty of his people, and gives him thrones of glory to inherit. He grants the request of those who pray to him and blesses the years of the righteous.
For a man's might is not by firmness.

The Lord makes his adversary weak; the Lord is holy. Let not the wise man boast in his wisdom, nor let the mighty man boast in his might, nor let the rich man boast in his riches; but let him who boasts boast in this: in understanding and knowing the Lord, and in doing righteous judgment upon the earth. The Lord has ascended in the heavens and has thundered; he himself will judge the ends of the earth by his righteousness. He will give strength to our king and will exalt the horn of his anointed.

O Lord, I heard the report of you and was afraid; O Lord, I considered your works and was amazed. Between the two living creatures you will appear; when your years draw near you will be revealed; when your times arrive you will be made known. In the trembling of my soul, in wrath you will remember mercy.
God will come from the south, and the Holy One from a shaded mountain of thickets. His beauty covered the heavens, and the earth was filled with his praise.
His brightness will be like light, and horns are in his hands. He will establish the firm love of his strength.
A word will go before his face, and it will pass across the plain following his footsteps.

He will stand, and the earth will shake; he will look upon the nations, and they will melt away. The mountains will be shattered by his fierceness, the high hills will melt, and his everlasting ways will be seen with toil.
The dwellings of the Ethiopians will tremble, and the tents of the land of Midian.
Are you angered against the rivers, O Lord? Or is your wrath upon the rivers, or your course upon the sea? For you have mounted your chariots, and your cavalry is salvation.
[?] I will take up my bow against the tribes, says the Lord. The land of rivers will be split open.
The peoples will see you and will be in anguish, as you scatter the course of the waters; and the abyss gave forth its voice by the multitude of his wonders.
The sun rose up, and the moon stood in its order; your arrows will go as light, and your weapon as the brightness of lightning.
By speaking you will diminish the earth, and in wrath you will make the nations tremble.
You went forth as savior of your people and to deliver your anointed ones. You sent death upon the heads of the lawless; you raised bonds up to their necks, completely.
You crushed the heads of the mighty with amazement; they will be shaken by it, and their cheeks will open, as when a poor man eats in secret.
Your horses will go upon the sea, stirring up many waters.

I kept watch, and my heart trembled at the sound of the prayer of my lips; trembling lodged in my bones, and my body trembled within me. I will rest in the day of my distress, when I go up to the people of my sojourning.

For the fig tree did not yield its fruit, and the produce of the vine was not found; the work of the olive failed, and the field did not bring forth green plants. The sheep were deprived of food, and no oxen were found at the manger.
But I will rejoice in the Lord and be glad in God my Savior.
The Lord my God is my strength; he has made my feet entirely firm. He has set me upon the height, to be victorious by his song.
From the night my spirit has risen early to you, O God, for your commandments are light upon the earth. Learn righteousness, you inhabitants of the earth.
For the ungodly one has been silenced. Everyone who does not learn righteousness on the earth will not do truth. Let the ungodly one be destroyed, so that he may not see the glory of God.
O Lord God Most High, your arm is strong, and they did not know it. Let them know and be ashamed. Jealousy will seize the untaught people, and fire will devour those enemies of yours.
O Lord our God, give us peace, for you have repaid us everything.
O Lord our God, acquire us for yourself. For apart from you we know no other, and we name your name always.
Now then, will the dead not see life, and will physicians not raise them up? Therefore you brought it upon them, blotted out and destroyed all their offspring.
Add [?] evil upon their evil; add [?], O Lord, evil to those glorious ones of the earth.
O Lord, in tribulation we will remember you, for your instruction upon us is a small tribulation.
Like the pain of a woman giving birth, when she suffers at the time of childbirth [?] and cries out from that pain, so we became in your love.

O Lord, through fear of you we conceived, we were in pain, and we gave birth. We have made the spirit of your salvation on the earth, so that we may not fall, but let the inhabitants of the earth be brought down.
The dead will rise, they will arise from the tomb, and they will rejoice on the earth. For the dew that comes from you is healing for them, but the land of the ungodly will fall.
I cried out in my tribulation to the Lord my God, and he heard me. From the belly of hell you heard the voice of my crying.
For you cast me down into the depth of the heart of the sea, and rivers surrounded me. All your surges [?] and your waves passed over me.
And I said: Am I indeed cast out from the sight of your eyes? Or shall I yet again look toward your holy temple?
The waters poured over me even to my soul, and the abysses surrounded me. My head went down into the clefts of the mountains.
I went down into the earth, whose bars are like everlasting locks. Let my life come up from corruption to you, O Lord my God.
When my soul was failing, I remembered the Lord. Let my prayer come before you, into your holy temple.
Those who keep vain and false things have abandoned their mercy [?].
But I, with the voice of praise and confession, will offer sacrifice to you. As much as I have vowed, I will give to you, the Lord, for my salvation.
Blessed are you, O Lord God of our fathers, and your name is praised and glorified forever.
For with justice you have done all this to us, for you are righteous, O Lord. All your works are in truth, and your ways are upright, and all your judgment is righteous.

For you sent a judgment of righteousness upon us in all that you sent upon us and upon the holy city of our fathers, Jerusalem. In truth and righteousness you sent all this upon us because of our sins.
For we have sinned against you. In everything we became lawless and we departed from you. We have sinned in every way; we did not listen to your commandments, and we did not keep them,
nor did we do as you commanded us, so that good might have come to us from you.
Now everything that you sent upon us and all that you have done to us, you did by a judgment of righteousness.
You gave us into the hands of our lawless, harsh, apostate enemies and into the hands of a lawless king; you gave us over to one more wicked than all the earth.
And it is not the time to lift up our face, for shame and reproach have come upon your slaves and your servants.
Do not give us up completely, for the sake of your name; do not annul your covenant,
and do not take your mercy away from us, for the sake of Abraham your beloved, Isaac your servant, and Israel your holy one,
to whom you spoke and said: I will multiply your descendants like the stars of the sky and like the sand on the seashore.
And now, Lord, we have become fewer than all the nations, and we are brought low in all the earth today because of our sins,
and at this time there is no prince, prophet, or leader, nor offerings of rams, nor incense, nor a place of sacrifice to make offering before you and to find mercy.
But with a humbled head and a spirit of poverty may we be offered, as if offerings of rams and of bulls, and as if myriads of fitting lambs;
so may this our sacrifice be offered before you today, that we may be perfect in following you, and that all who rely on you may not be put to shame.
Now we follow you with all our heart; we fear you; we seek your face. Lord, do not put us to shame,
but deal with us in your mercy, in your sweetness and in your abundant mercy.
Deliver us by your wonders, and glorify your name, Lord,
that all who do evil to your servants may be ashamed; let their tyrannies be put to shame, and let all their strength be shattered.
And let them understand that you are the Lord God, the only one, exalted and glorious over all the world.
And the king's servants, who had thrown the three youths into the kindled furnace, did not cease; they kept stoking the furnace with naphtha, pitch, tow, and vine cuttings.
The flame went up and rose above the furnace forty-nine cubits;
it came and enveloped and burned all those of the Chaldeans whom it found around the furnace.
At that time the angel of the Lord came down among Azariah and his companions and scattered the flame out of the fiery furnace.
He made in the midst of the furnace of fire and flame something like a wind of dew, a breeze; the fire did not touch them at all. It did not distress them, nor harm them in any way.
Then all three youths, as if with one mouth, sang, blessed, and glorified God in the furnace, and said:
Blessed are you, Lord God of our fathers, praised, glorified, and exalted forever; blessed is the holy name of your glory, praised, glorified, and exalted forever.
Blessed are you in the holy temple of your glory, praised, glorified, and exalted forever.
Blessed are you who sit upon the cherubim and look upon the abysses, praised, glorified, and exalted forever.
Blessed are you on the thrones of your kingdom, praised, glorified, and exalted forever.
Blessed are you on the firmament of the heaven of heavens, praised, blessed, glorified, and supremely exalted forever, amen.
Bless the Lord, all you works of the Lord;
bless the Lord, you heavens and angels of the Lord;
Bless the Lord, all you waters above the heavens, you powers of the Lord;
Bless the Lord, sun and moon, you stars of heaven;
Bless the Lord, rain and dew, all you winds.
Bless the Lord, fire and heat, nights and days;
Bless the Lord, light and darkness, cold and warmth.
Bless the Lord, frost and snow, lightnings and clouds;
Let the earth, the mountains and the hills bless the Lord;
Let every plant of the earth, the sea and the rivers bless the Lord.
Let the springs, the sea monsters and all that move in the waters bless the Lord.
Bless the Lord, birds of the sky, wild beasts and all cattle;
Bless the Lord, you children of men; let Israel bless the Lord,
Bless the Lord, priests of the Lord, servants of the Lord;
Let the spirits and souls of the righteous, the worthy and the humble of heart, bless the Lord;
Bless the Lord, Hananiah, Azariah, Mishael.
My soul magnifies the Lord.
And let my spirit rejoice in God my Savior,
for he has looked upon the lowliness of his handmaid; behold, from now on all generations will call me blessed;
for the Mighty One has done great things with me; holy is his name,
and his mercy is from generation to generation upon those who fear him.
He has acted with the strength of his arm; he has scattered the proud in the thought of their hearts;
he has cast down the mighty from their thrones and has lifted up the lowly;
he has filled the hungry with good things and has sent the rich away empty;
he has received Israel his servant, in remembrance of his mercy;
as he spoke to our father Abraham and to his offspring forever.
Blessed is the Lord God of Israel, for he has looked upon us and has brought about the redemption of his people;
He has raised up for us a horn of salvation in the house of David his servant,
as he spoke through the mouth of his holy prophets of old:
deliverance from our enemies and from the hands of all who hate us;
to show mercy to our fathers, to remember his holy law;
we know that he swore to Abraham our father to grant us
that, delivered from the hands of our enemies, without fear
that we should serve him in worthiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life;
And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High, for you will go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways,
to give knowledge of salvation to his people through the forgiveness of our sins,
through the compassion and mercy of our God, by which the sun rising from on high has appeared to us,
to shine upon those who sit in darkness and the shadows of death, so as to direct our feet in the way of peace.
